text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Now they're in the final stretch! Charging up the hill!!
What will happen from here?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Kh, it's tough, but...!
I can still see the path, I can still hear their voices!
The time to make my move is now—!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ――I won't let you!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Here comes Hokko Tarumae!! Hokko Tarumae is surging forward!! She's making her move now!!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!? No way...!!
Tarumae's move completely turned the tables...!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (Just as Rickey chased after me, I've been waiting for Rickey too, you know!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(I'm confident that today, I understand everyone's style
better than anyone else here!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Hokko Tarumae crosses the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "As of this very moment, Hokko Tarumae is on the verge of a historic milestone—one win away from the all-time record for most G1 victories!"
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
This is getting crazy! If Hokko Tarumae
manages to win the Tokyo Daishoten...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Winning two GⅠs in a single month, and on top of that,
achieving the most GⅠ wins in history!?
Th-That's just way too incredible...!!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —I'm so glad I made it in time, seriously.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh!! I lost~~~~!!
Tarumae's just way too strong after all~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There, there, who's a good girl, Rickey-chan?
Still, that was seriously an incredible run.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Because I decided that I was going to win!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...This is who I am, Rickey.
And—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the dirt forefront.
To our stage!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...So that's how Tarumae took the plunge too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
And from now on, we'll be running ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Tarumae, are you sure you don't want to try feng shui after all?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're recruiting me after all that?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—In the final stretch,
Tarumae completely rewrote everything I was seeing with her running.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I was just wondering what would happen if we channeled that powerful qi through feng shui.
I really think they've got talent for it~☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Rickey really is tough in that way.
I wish I could have taught last year's me to take a leaf out of her book.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—At the Tokyo Daishoten,
I'll show you my feng shui and running once again.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I won't underestimate Tarumae's strength this time.
I'll use what I learned today to take full control of the field next time!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Just what I wanted!
I'll strike back even harder than today!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...So that's how it all connects.

...The day after the Champions Cup.
The news arrived without warningâ

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What on earth could this be about?
Falco-san's emergency livestream, that is—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I really hope so, but—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's starting.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for tuning in for Falco's announcement today☆
So without further ado, here's the big news!!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Falco will be making a surprise entry into this year's Tokyo Daishoten!!!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I really, reaaally pushed my luck
to squeeze myself in this time!
But, but—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"That's how much I wanted to run!
How much I wanted to shine!!
On the dirt right now, together with everyone!!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"‘To all the fans who cheered me on!
To everyone running on the dirt!!
Falco is coming over to you!!!’"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: “Let's meet at Oi Racecourse!!”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Falco-san—
choice_data_list: ...Now we can repay the favor directly.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

The Tokyo Daishoten, where brilliance and dreams gather,
was fast approaching...!
